name: course-to-short-video
description: Turn a full-length course or lesson video into a short (~20-30s) 9:16 vertical clip for organic social sharing. It finds the strongest sections, cuts on complete thoughts, adds clean word-by-word subtitles, smooth crossfades, and a light music bed, then appends a branded end card.
author: Official

examples.caption: Back to Eden Gardening course video cut into a ~30s vertical share clip with branded end card
